name: Kimpton Seafire Resort
positioning: Family-friendly Kimpton beach resort on the quieter northern stretch of Seven Mile Beach, officially Kimpton Seafire Resort + Spa
best_for: Families who want kids club and suite options
Guests who like a quieter stretch of Seven Mile Beach

facts.text: Kimpton Seafire opened in 2016 on Seven Mile Beach.
The resort sits on the quieter northern stretch of Seven Mile Beach, away from the busier central areas.
Library by the Sea serves inventive cocktails inspired by literature.
The oceanfront suites have private outdoor soaking tubs.
The Family Suite has a separate bedroom for parents and a living area with bunk beds for the kids.
The resort has a dedicated kids club.
The hotel offers complimentary kayaks, paddleboards and bicycles.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, whatever their size, weight or breed.
Parking is at no charge for guests and is included in the resort fee.

highlights.text: A fully restored traditional Cayman catboat hangs in the resort's library.
The resort's outdoor lighting is turtle-friendly, so nesting sea turtles and hatchlings are guided back to the water by moonlight.
The spa has a hammam-inspired steam room with tiles flown in from Turkey.

considerations.text: There is no complimentary local area shuttle at the resort.
The resort is on the quieter northern stretch of Seven Mile Beach, away from the busier central areas.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury Cayman Islands resorts.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton Seafire Resort & Spa
